title: Scoring stores a per-assessment score snapshot
detail: skill_assessments.score is stored at write time and preferred by computeCompetencyScore, so old weights do not rewrite existing assessment rows (except zero scores).

title: Login and refresh path uses bcrypt cost 12 and a login rate limiter
detail: Passwords hashed with bcryptjs cost 12; express-rate-limit on login.

title: Validation on every config write route
detail: All post/put/patch routes in config.router.ts use validate(zod schema), with parsed data replacing req.body.

title: AI has deterministic fallback and bounded inputs
detail: Failures fall back to a deterministic answer; question clamped to 600 chars; focus allow-listed; output coerced to a fixed shape.

title: Multi-step config writes use transactions with audit rows
detail: createEmployee and line-manager flows use db.$transaction with tx.accessAuditLog.

title: DB-level guard on CEFR scale
detail: Trigger cefr_levels_scale_lock protects the scale in the database.

title: Security headers, CORS pinned, body limit
detail: helmet with HSTS, CORS restricted to FRONTEND_URL, 1mb JSON limit.
